# PalmCacia

> PalmCacia is a stock and crypto trading platform for Zambian and global retail traders. It combines Robinhood-style stock trading with a Binance-style crypto exchange interface, plus Zambian (LuSE) and other African market access, portfolio tools, watchlists and research.

## What PalmCacia offers

- US stocks: browse, research and trade US-listed shares.
- Crypto: trade major cryptocurrencies through an exchange-style interface.
- Zambian market access: Lusaka Securities Exchange (LuSE) shares and other African markets.
- Tools: portfolio tracking, watchlists, price alerts, market research and news.

## How execution works (current stage — stated plainly)

- US stocks and Alpaca-listed crypto execute via the Alpaca sandbox (paper) broker. This is paper trading, not live-money execution, at this stage.
- Zambian (LuSE) and other African markets, and P2P crypto, are simulated at this stage.
- A LuSE partnership is in talks; no partnership has been signed yet. Simulated markets are not live markets.

## Who it is for

- Zambian retail traders who want US stocks, crypto and local-market access in one platform.
- Global retail traders interested in African market exposure alongside US stocks and crypto.

## Key facts

- Brand name: PalmCacia (one word). The product is also known as PalmTrader Horizon.
- Founder: Mabvuto Banda.
- Website: https://palmtrader-horizon.lovable.app/
